description: A screen-time report with stacked category bars, a week and day toggle, selectable days and a most-used apps list.
overview: A full screen-time report: stacked category bars per day, a Week and Day toggle, selectable days, per-category totals and a most-used apps list that all update together. Use it as a reference for building a drill-down dashboard on top of a bar chart.
usage: Replace `USAGE` with your per-day category totals and `APPS` with your item breakdown, and rename the categories in `CATEGORIES` and `chartConfig`. The hourly Day view is generated from the daily totals for the demo, so feed it real hourly data in production. The comparison line under the headline is a fixed string until a day is selected.
notes: Click, tap or press Return on a bar to select a day, and select it again to clear the selection; taps that move like a scroll are ignored. Day view shows Sunday if no day was selected. The header is a live region so selection changes are announced.
